## Validation

- [ ] I searched existing issues and contributions for this locality.
- [ ] The design uses original vector geometry and documents meaningful simplifications.
- [ ] SVG has a 36×36 canvas, rounded flag silhouette and transparent padding.
- [ ] No scripts, embedded images, external SVG resources, fonts, gradients or shadows.
- [ ] `npm run export:cities` and `npm run verify` pass (city contributions).
- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run export` and `npm run verify` pass (state changes).
- [ ] Metadata includes the sources, locality identifier and contributor credit.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution. I agree to license my original artwork under CC BY 4.0 and code/documentation under MIT.
